site.name: Awardley
site.description: One record of what a client asked for, what suppliers quoted, what you bid, and whether you won.

hero.headline: Every tender, on one record.
hero.sub: What the client asked for, what suppliers quoted, what you bid, and whether you won. One workspace for trading companies, in English and 中文.
hero.screenshotAlt: A Tender in Awardley, as seen on a phone, showing its Items and the Quotes against them.

sheet.caption: An example Quotes sheet: four Items down the left, three suppliers across, the selected Quote for each Item marked, and the Bid built from those four.
sheet.hint: Pick a supplier’s price — the Bid follows.

problem.title: The tender is in six places, and the deadline is in someone's head

stale.title: The bid goes out on a price that has moved
stale.body: A supplier revised on Tuesday; the sheet in the bid was saved on Monday.

missed.title: The supplier nobody chased
missed.body: One Item still has no quote against it on the morning the bid is due.

lost.title: Nothing left to look back at
lost.body: Six months on, no record of who quoted what, or why that supplier won.

how.title: From the client's request to the bid you send

tender.title: A Tender, and every Item under it
tender.body: Every Item the client asked for, recorded with its own quantity and specification.

quotes.title: Quotes compared on one sheet
quotes.body: Rule out what does not fit, select what does, and the Bid follows.

assignees.title: Assignees, and Reminders by email
assignees.body: One Reminder, to the one person it is about, in the language they read.

who.title: Built for the people who actually chase the quotes

owner.title: The owner
owner.body: Compares every supplier's price on one sheet before the bid goes out.

assignee.title: The colleague chasing a supplier
assignee.body: Gets one Reminder in their inbox, in the language they read.

team.title: The whole team
team.body: On a desk or a phone, in English or 中文, looking at the same record.

suppliers.q: Do our suppliers need an account?
suppliers.a: No — you record what they quoted; they send it however they already do.

spreadsheet.q: What happens to the spreadsheet we use now?
spreadsheet.a: The Quotes sheet replaces it, with the arithmetic taken out of your hands.

language.q: Can half the team work in 中文?
language.a: Yes — English or 中文, chosen per person, over one shared record.

data.a: In one database behind the login; this page collects only an email address.

beta.title: Awardley is in closed beta
beta.body: The app is invite-only while we work with our first companies. Leave your email and we will keep you posted as it opens up.
beta.success: Check your inbox. We have sent you a link to confirm — it is good for 48 hours.
beta.invalid: That does not look like an email address.
beta.failed: Something went wrong at our end. Try again in a moment.
beta.privacyNote: One email to confirm, then occasional updates. Unsubscribe any time.

footer.tagline: One record of what a client asked for, what suppliers quoted, what you bid, and whether you won.

ready.title: One more step
ready.body: Press the button and this address joins the list. Nothing is stored until you do.

ok.title: You are on the list
ok.body: We will email you when there is something worth saying about Awardley, and nothing else. Every message carries an unsubscribe link.

failed.title: That did not go through
failed.body: We could not add you just now. Your link is still valid; try again in a few minutes.

expired.title: That link has expired
expired.body: Confirmation links are good for 48 hours. Enter your email again and we will send a fresh one.

email.subject: Confirm your email for Awardley updates
email.body:
Someone — we hope you — asked for updates on Awardley, a tender workspace for trading companies.

Confirm that address by opening this link and pressing the button:

{link}

The link is good for 48 hours. If this was not you, ignore this email: nothing is stored unless you confirm.

— Awardley

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page covers the waiting list on this site and nothing else. It is short because we collect very little.

what.title: What we collect
what.body: An email address, and only if you type one into the form on this page. No name, no company, no phone number. The form does not set a cookie. The language switch in the footer stores the language you picked in a cookie for a year, and nothing else.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.body: To send you updates on the Awardley project. Nothing else. We do not sell it, rent it, or pass it to anyone for their own use.

where.title: Where it is held
where.body: In an audience at Resend, the service that sends our email. Resend is a United States provider, so your address is held and processed outside Thailand. Your address is not added there until you confirm it from the email we send you — if you never confirm, nothing is ever stored.

long.title: How long we keep it
long.body: Until you unsubscribe or ask us to remove it. There is no other expiry: we are not going to decide on your behalf that you have stopped being interested.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: This site uses Vercel Web Analytics, which is cookieless. It counts page views and where they came from. It does not set a cookie, does not follow you to other sites, and collects no personal data about you.

remove.title: How to be removed
remove.body: Use the unsubscribe link at the foot of any email we send you, or write to hello@awardley.com and ask. Either one is enough; you do not have to give a reason.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: Peerawit Chariyawongsiri, who runs Awardley as an individual, is the controller of this data. Questions, corrections and complaints go to hello@awardley.com.
